verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitLab offers built-in CI/CD (docs-19, docs-30) and is available as a hosted service on GitLab.com (docs-49). A community report describes GitLab.com's own CI workers failing to run (comm-1), which implies platform-run CI capacity exists, but no documentation explicitly describes GitLab-hosted runners. The only runner-specific doc mentions installing GitLab Runner on your own cluster (docs-43), which is the opposite of no-infrastructure management. Missing for 10: first-party docs on platform-hosted runners, details on runner OS/machine types and quotas, and evidence that hosted runners work reliably.
